name: CodAgentBench
description: CodAgentBench is a benchmark dataset introduced to evaluate the effectiveness of CodeAgent, an LLM-based agent framework designed for repo-level code generation challenges. It measures performance improvements in real-world repository-level coding tasks involving complex dependencies and documentation.
reputation: A niche but useful repo-level code generation benchmark cited in work on agentic coding systems, though it is not yet a widely standardized community leaderboard.
notes: First benchmark specifically for repo-level code generation; demonstrates significant performance improvements over existing methods and commercial products.
